Proposition
[ODE criterion for a fixed convex set] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0064, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0065, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0066 ↗ lem:chow-ii-distance-support ↗ cor:chow-ii-dini-monotonicity 1. ch10:10.54\group Convex geometry

The ODE $U'=F(U,t)$ preserves a closed convex set $\mathcal J$ iff $\ell (F(V,t))\le 0$ for every boundary point $V$ and support function $\ell $ at $V$.
Proof

\sketch If the inequality fails, the derivative of $\ell (U(t))$ at the boundary points outward. Conversely, for $s(t)=d(U(t),\mathcal J)$, the distance-support formula and local Lipschitz continuity give $d^+s/dt\le Cs$ whenever $s>0$; since $s(t_0)=0$, the Dini barrier yields $s=0$.

□
